controls.label: Refund limit
controls.why: The largest single refund this merchant may issue. Above it the engine denies with `amount_limit_exceeded` rather than asking for approval -- a limit is a limit, not a prompt.

controls.label: Auto-approve below
controls.why: NOT IMPLEMENTED. This key is stored on every merchant and read by no code path -- setting it changes nothing. It is listed so that is visible rather than assumed.

controls.label: Approval expires after
controls.why: Platform-wide. An approval that outlives the situation it was granted for is a signature on a decision nobody is still making (§21).

controls.label: Two signatures on high risk
controls.why: Not configurable on purpose. A control a merchant can switch off under pressure is one that is off when it matters (§25).

controls.label: Risk is computed, never declared
controls.why: Risk comes from the registry, the arguments and the database. A caller-supplied risk level is a caller grading their own homework (§24).
